description: Defaults for unattended runs. The owner overrides any of them once with `softory charter approve <file>` at a terminal; the result lives in local.json. Agents read it with `softory charter show` and never change it.

epics.description: Epics inside these limits start without the owner's go/no-go. Greg raises an escalation to the owner for anything bigger.

budget.description: Caps per role per day, in runs and minutes, so they hold whatever the model costs. Set for Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra; tune after a week of softory usage. The usd caps are off at 0; usd_per_run is enforced by Claude Code itself, and the daily usd cap counts the cost each run reports. roles overrides any cap for one role.

review_batch.description: Wake a reviewer once this many reviews wait, or once the oldest has waited this long, so one run clears several. Reviews also wait until softory verify passes at the commit.

permissions.description: Claude Code runs each role with a settings file built from these and its lane paths. Commands are prefixes.

effort.description: Reasoning effort by kind of run: review when a role only has reviews, closes, or messages waiting, otherwise build. models.<role>.effort overrides it for one role.

prices.description: USD per million tokens, used only when a harness reports tokens but no cost (Codex). Check them against your plan.

models.description: Per role: the default harness and model, and an optional stronger one used once a task has had escalate_model_after rounds of requested changes. Chosen on 2026-10-24 from benchmarks that fit each role's work; see docs/models.md.
